title: The Freshmen: Elissa Slotkin Confronts the Impeachment Backlash

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zoran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Days after moderate House Democrats announced they would support an impeachment inquiry against President Trump.
sentences.zh: 几天前，温和派民主党众议员宣布他们将支持对特朗普总统进行弹劾调查。

sentences.en: They were turned home to their swing districts on recess.
sentences.zh: 随后他们休会回到各自的摇摆选区。

sentences.en: It's the first time they've faced their constituents since that decision.
sentences.zh: 这是他们做出该决定后首次面对选民。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Alyssa Slotkin of Michigan went to three town halls last week.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州众议员艾丽莎·斯洛特金上周参加了三场市政厅会议。

sentences.en: We went with her to all of them.
sentences.zh: 我们陪同她参加了所有这些会议。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月9日，星期三。

sentences.en: Congresswoman, I'd love for you to go back to a couple of weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 众议员，我想请你回顾一下几周前的情况。

sentences.en: You're headed home to your district in Michigan for the first time since you've made this decision that you surely knew would upset many of your constituents.
sentences.zh: 你当时正准备回到密歇根州的选区，这是你做出那个你肯定知道会激怒许多选民的决定后首次回家。

sentences.en: Was there any question in your mind whether you would hold town halls while you were back in your district?
sentences.zh: 在你回到选区时，你有没有考虑过是否要举行市政厅会议？

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, what we actually did was add more.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们实际上还增加了场次。

sentences.en: I obviously knew that the decision was going to be controversial.
sentences.zh: 我显然知道这个决定会引起争议。

sentences.en: So, no, it was more important than anything for me to get in front of my district and go to the three counties in three days.
sentences.zh: 所以，不，对我来说，最重要的事情就是面对我的选区，在三天内走访三个县。

sentences.en: Hi there.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: My name is Mella.
sentences.zh: 我叫梅拉。

sentences.en: I'm the Congresswoman's Chief of Staff.
sentences.zh: 我是众议员的幕僚长。

sentences.en: And first and foremost, we did not expect such a big turnout.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们没想到会有这么多人参加。

sentences.en: In the very first one that we did was just walking into the Grand Traverse Pie Company in East Lansing and just basically not being able to get in the door.
sentences.zh: 我们举办的第一场活动是在东兰辛的 Grand Traverse Pie Company，当时我们甚至连门都挤不进去。

sentences.en: Now, it was surprising how many people were there and just the physical getting in the room, finding a tiny little corner where I could speak from,
sentences.zh: 现场人数之多令人惊讶，我们甚至很难进入房间，只能找个小角落作为演讲点，

sentences.en: making sure people could hear me in the way back.
sentences.zh: 还要确保最后面的人能听到我的声音。

sentences.en: Don't you guys have anything else going on in the middle of the day?
sentences.zh: 你们这些人白天难道没事做吗？

sentences.en: My gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I'm thrilled to see so many people here.
sentences.zh: 看到这么多人来到这里，我感到非常激动。

sentences.en: I wanted to come home to the district and make sure that everybody heard from me directly on what's gone on in the past week, week and a half.
sentences.zh: 我回到选区就是为了确保每个人都能直接从我这里了解过去一周到一周半发生的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, for me, it felt like this is how it's supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我觉得这才是它本该有的运作方式。

sentences.en: You know, not everything is going to be, you know, unanimously supported by my district.
sentences.zh: 你知道，并不是所有事情都会得到我选区的一致支持。

sentences.en: And at a bare minimum, whether people agree with me or not, my job is to make myself available and to let my constituents hear from me directly.
sentences.zh: 但最起码，无论人们是否同意我，我的工作就是让自己随时待命，让我的选民能直接听到我的声音。

sentences.en: In the past week, myself and six other members of the freshman class, all service and veteran folks, all made the decision to come out.
sentences.zh: 过去一周，我和其他六位新当选的议员，都是有服役背景的退伍军人，我们都决定站出来。

sentences.en: We wrote a joint op-ed to the Washington PoSt. I wrote a similar one here in the Free Press to explain our decision making and why we are calling for an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 我们为《华盛顿邮报》写了一篇联合评论文章。我也在《自由新闻报》上写了一篇类似的文章，来解释我们的决策过程以及我们为何呼吁进行弹劾调查。

sentences.en: And I will be honest with you, this was a decision that I did not come to lightly.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这个决定我做得并不轻松。

sentences.en: It is not something that I went to Congress to do.
sentences.zh: 这不是我进入国会想要做的事情。

sentences.en: Many of you know, because you called my office, I was reticent to call for impeachment in earlier iterations.
sentences.zh: 你们很多人都知道，因为你们给我的办公室打过电话，我在早些时候对呼吁弹劾持保留态度。

sentences.en: But for me, what happened in the past week or week and a half was really something different.
sentences.zh: 但对我来说，过去一周或一周半发生的事情确实不同寻常。

sentences.en: The key and sort of most important piece of information is that the President of the United States, the Commander-in-Chief, reached out to
sentences.zh: 最关键、最重要的信息是，美国总统，即三军统帅，联系了

sentences.en: a foreign president and asked for dirt on an American, on a political opponent.
sentences.zh: 一位外国总统，要求获取关于一名美国人、一名政治对手的黑料。

sentences.en: Involving foreigners in our elections in any way, I feel like has no place in our politics.
sentences.zh: 我觉得以任何方式让外国人卷入我们的选举，在我们的政治中都是没有立足之地的。

sentences.en: Today, it could be a
sentences.zh: 今天，可能是

sentences.en: Republican asking a Ukrainian.
sentences.zh: 共和党人要求乌克兰人这样做。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, it could be a Democrat asking the Chinese to dig up dirt, and on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 明天，就可能是民主党人要求中国人去挖掘黑料，如此循环往复。

sentences.en: The idea that there would be any question as to how we got the president that we got, that foreigners played any role in it, was just beyond the pale for me.
sentences.zh: 对于我们如何选出现在的总统，如果有人质疑外国人是否在其中扮演了任何角色，这对我来说简直是不可接受的。

sentences.en: So I felt it was something that I had to do to uphold my oath of office.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到这是我为了履行就职誓言必须做的事情。

sentences.en: And there were people there with strong opinions on both sides of the aisle.
sentences.zh: 现场有来自两党、观点鲜明的人。

sentences.en: There were people who were extremely supportive and had just shown up to thank me for the decision.
sentences.zh: 有些人非常支持，他们特地赶来感谢我做出这个决定。

sentences.en: And there were people who had just shown up, you know, to demonstrate their displeasure.
sentences.zh: 也有一些人赶来，你知道，是为了表达他们的不满。

sentences.en: And, you know, we had to cut it short because the fire marshal was called.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我们不得不提前结束，因为消防局长被叫来了。

sentences.en: Because the crowd was too big.
sentences.zh: 因为人群太多了。

sentences.en: The crowd was too big, and it started to be too much for the venue.
sentences.zh: 人群太多了，场地开始承受不住了。

sentences.en: And so we had to cut it a little bit short.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不得不稍微缩短了时间。

sentences.en: So my read from listening to the first of these events that you did, the one that was broken up
sentences.zh: 根据我对你参加的第一场活动的观察，也就是那场最终被消防局长叫停的活动，

sentences.en: eventually by the fire marshal, is that people were largely supportive of your decision on the impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 人们在很大程度上支持你关于弹劾调查的决定。

sentences.en: But that might have something to do with the fact that you were in a bluer part of your district, right?
sentences.zh: 但这可能与你当时身处选区中较偏向民主党的地区有关，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: That first one in East Lansing, I mean, that just happens to be a more heavily
sentences.zh: 第一场在东兰辛的活动，那恰好是一个

sentences.en: Democratic area.
sentences.zh: 民主党势力较强的地区。

sentences.en: And so there were more people per capita that were supportive.
sentences.zh: 所以按人均计算，支持的人更多。

sentences.en: So let's talk about the second event that you did.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈你参加的第二场活动。

sentences.en: Can you give us a picture of that part of your congressional district?
sentences.zh: 你能给我们描述一下你选区的那一部分吗？

sentences.en: So Livingston County is more rural than the other two counties.
sentences.zh: 利文斯顿县比其他两个县更偏向农村。

sentences.en: It's a place that's changing, but that tends to be the most conservative part of the district.
sentences.zh: 这是一个正在发生变化的地方，但它往往是该选区最保守的部分。

sentences.en: And what percentage would you say of the constituents there supported President Trump, and what percentage supported you?
sentences.zh: 你认为那里的选民中有多少百分比支持特朗普总统，又有多少百分比支持你？

sentences.en: So I'd have to look at the exact numbers, but the entire district voted for Donald Trump by seven points.
sentences.zh: 我得查一下确切的数字，但整个选区以七个百分点的优势投票给了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And I'm sure in Livingston County, it was stronger than that.
sentences.zh: 我相信在利文斯顿县，这个比例更高。

sentences.en: I used to joke that our goal in Livingston County was to lose better.
sentences.zh: 我过去常开玩笑说，我们在利文斯顿县的目标是输得好看一点。

sentences.en: And we did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实做到了。

sentences.en: We won certain areas like the town of Brighton.
sentences.zh: 我们在布莱顿镇等某些地区赢了。

sentences.en: And in certain areas, we won 50% of the vote.
sentences.zh: 在某些地区，我们赢得了50%的选票。

sentences.en: But there are certain towns in that area where less than 35%.
sentences.zh: 但该地区有些城镇的支持率不到35%。

sentences.en: The other piece that obviously I'm sure many of you are here to talk about today is the issue of an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 另一件我相信你们很多人今天来这里想谈的事情，就是弹劾调查的问题。

sentences.en: So let me...
sentences.zh: 所以让我……

sentences.en: So I found it pretty interesting that you could tell right out of the gate that this second town hall was going to be different.
sentences.zh: 我发现很有趣的一点是，你从一开始就能看出这第二场市政厅会议会有所不同。

sentences.en: The issue that got to me was this idea that the president, the most powerful man in the world,
sentences.zh: 让我感到困扰的问题是，总统，这个世界上最有权势的人，

sentences.en: reached out to a foreigner, a foreign leader, and asked him to dig up dirt on an American, on a political approach.
sentences.zh: 联系了一位外国人、一位外国领导人，并要求他挖掘一名美国人、一名政治对手的黑料。

sentences.en: This is...
sentences.zh: 这是……

sentences.en: We didn't ask for that.
sentences.zh: 我们没有要求那样做。

sentences.en: Don't lie.
sentences.zh: 别撒谎。

sentences.en: Fake news.
sentences.zh: 假新闻。

sentences.en: Don't lie into it.
sentences.zh: 别在那儿撒谎了。

sentences.en: He's your president.
sentences.zh: 他是你的总统。

sentences.en: Foreign leaders help you.
sentences.zh: 外国领导人是在帮你。

sentences.en: It juSt...
sentences.zh: 这简直……

sentences.en: I'm sorry, ma'am.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，女士。

sentences.en: They don't help out.
sentences.zh: 他们不是在帮忙。

sentences.en: This isn't your job.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的工作。

sentences.en: Do your job.
sentences.zh: 做好你的工作。

sentences.en: And for me, it was extremely...
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这极其……

sentences.en: I want the answers.
sentences.zh: 我想要答案。

sentences.en: You know, for Michigan, which is a swing state, you know, where we grew up having, you know, mixed families.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于密歇根州这个摇摆州来说，我们是在混合家庭中长大的。

sentences.en: My dad was a Republican.
sentences.zh: 我父亲是共和党人。

sentences.en: My mom was a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 我母亲是民主党人。

sentences.en: We have a long tradition of being able to disagree without it being vitriolic.
sentences.zh: 我们有长期保持不同意见而不进行恶毒攻击的传统。

sentences.en: And what's been hard for us, frankly, I think as a state, is that some of that vitriol that's in Washington has been imported to Michigan.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，作为这个州的一员，我认为让我们感到困难的是，华盛顿的一些恶毒言论被引入了密歇根州。

sentences.en: And it's made our Thanksgiving dinners uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这让我们的感恩节晚餐变得不舒服。

sentences.en: Moms will tell me all the time, I don't want to talk to, you know, other moms when I drop my son off at school because I don't want to walk on any minefields.
sentences.zh: 妈妈们总是告诉我，当我送儿子上学时，我不想和其他妈妈交谈，因为我不想踩到任何地雷。

sentences.en: You know, everyone's walking on eggshells on politics here, and that's never how we work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这里的每个人在政治问题上都如履薄冰，而我们从来不是这样工作的。

sentences.en: I'm going to wait for the facts.
sentences.zh: 我会等待事实。

sentences.en: I'm going to look at them judiciously.
sentences.zh: 我会审慎地审视它们。

sentences.en: I'm going to understand the sourcing.
sentences.zh: 我会去了解消息来源。

sentences.en: I'm going to do what I was trained to do, which is to look at the investor.
sentences.zh: 我会做我受过训练要做的事，那就是审视调查者。

sentences.en: So I really noticed that in this town hall, the way that kind of national political talking points kept coming up again and again.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实注意到，在那场市政厅会议上，那种全国性的政治谈话要点不断地被反复提及。

sentences.en: So I want to get into that.
sentences.zh: 所以我想深入探讨一下。

sentences.en: There was this fascinating exchange you had.
sentences.zh: 你们之间有一段非常引人注目的交流。

sentences.en: I wanted to tell you that even though we're at the opposite end, I sent you an email about immigration and you sent me the coolest letter.
sentences.zh: 我想告诉你，尽管我们立场相反，但我曾就移民问题给你发过邮件，你回了我一封超酷的信。

sentences.en: And I thought, wow, that's pretty neat.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，哇，那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Then I watched your interview on Fox News, and I thought, holy mackerel, this is a blue dog Democrat.
sentences.zh: 然后我看了你在福克斯新闻的采访，我想，天哪，这是一位蓝狗民主党人。

sentences.en: I like her.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢她。

sentences.en: But when you fell off the cliff for me was when you joined the coup against our president.
sentences.zh: 但当你加入针对我们总统的政变时，你就彻底让我失望了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it makes me really sad because you read the transcript, and so did I.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常难过，因为你读了那份通话记录，我也读了。

sentences.en: The word dirt wasn't in there.
sentences.zh: 里面根本没有“黑料”这个词。

sentences.en: And I don't like when you guys do that.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢你们那样做。

sentences.en: He was checking on corruption.
sentences.zh: 他是在调查腐败。

sentences.en: Where a woman expressed her frustration with you for your use of the word dirt in describing what the president was seeking on that call with the president of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 一位女士表达了她的不满，因为你在描述总统与乌克兰总统通话时，使用了“黑料”这个词。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about that exchange and what you made of it?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我那次交流以及你的想法吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I actually think that was an important point.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为那是一个重要的观点。

sentences.en: And people want to know that if we're going to go through this, that there's going to be objectivity to it.
sentences.zh: 人们想知道，如果我们非要经历这个过程，那它必须是客观的。

sentences.en: And language like that is not objective.
sentences.zh: 像那样的语言是不客观的。

sentences.en: I use the word dirt, which is subjective.
sentences.zh: 我用了“黑料”这个词，这是主观的。

sentences.en: I think that I've seen that over and over in my district, language can be very political.
sentences.zh: 我想我在我的选区反复看到过这一点，语言可以是非常政治化的。

sentences.en: It's like a dog whistle, you know.
sentences.zh: 就像一种政治暗语，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I made a point during my campaign to sort of clarify my language as much as possible and keep it out of political dog whistle words.
sentences.zh: 我在竞选期间特意尽量澄清我的语言，并尽量避免使用政治暗语。

sentences.en: I think that that was a relevant point.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是一个相关的观点。

sentences.en: So I want to know, in that five pages, and I read it, what denotes high crimes and misdemeanors?
sentences.zh: 所以我想知道，在那五页纸里，我读过了，什么构成了重罪和轻罪？

sentences.en: I mean, honestly, just be honest with us.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，老实说，对我们诚实一点。

sentences.en: Because, I mean, you're a smart kid.
sentences.zh: 因为，我的意思是，你是个聪明的孩子。

sentences.en: I mean, woman.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，女士。

sentences.en: Thank you for calling me a kid.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你叫我孩子。

sentences.en: I love a 43-year-old kid.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢被叫作43岁的孩子。

sentences.en: But I would like to know what specifically it was that jumps out at you.
sentences.zh: 但我很想知道具体是什么让你感到震惊。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So thank you for asking your question.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你提出这个问题。

sentences.en: I think the thing that was difficult for me, I have no individual knowledge on what happened or did not happen with the Biden family.
sentences.zh: 我认为让我感到困难的是，对于拜登家族发生了什么或没发生什么，我没有任何个人了解。

sentences.en: I just know that when you're not sure about something and you want to investigate, you go to the American authorities.

sentences.zh: 你离开这些市政厅会议时，对美国人如何看待世界和处理这一时刻是否有新的视角？

sentences.en: I mean, one of the things I was most surprised by, personally, was that most people at these
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我个人最惊讶的事情之一是，这些活动中的大多数人基本上都同意，美国总统要求外国领导人调查国内政治对手，并向该领导人施压要求这样做。

sentences.en: events were basically in agreement that the president of the United States asked a foreign leader to investigate a domestic political rival, pressured that leader to do so.
sentences.zh: 美国总统要求外国领导人调查国内政治对手，并向该领导人施压要求这样做。

sentences.en: But not everyone agrees that that was wrong.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有人都认为这是错误的。

sentences.en: Was that what was surprising for you as well?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说也感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: I was surprised that people thought that that was okay.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶人们认为那是可以接受的。

sentences.en: And I tried to give the example in Heartland that, hey, today it could be a Republican president reaching out to Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我在哈特兰试图举个例子，嘿，今天可能是一位共和党总统联系乌克兰。

sentences.en: Tomorrow it could be a Democratic president reaching out to China.
sentences.zh: 明天可能是一位民主党总统联系中国。

sentences.en: I think it has more of an impact on people because, you know, Ukraine might be difficult for folks to understand, especially since they're a partner nation.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对人们的影响更大，因为，你知道，乌克兰对人们来说可能很难理解，尤其是因为他们是一个伙伴国家。

sentences.en: But I think most people in Michigan understand that reaching out to China would be a bad thing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为密歇根州的大多数人都明白，联系中国是一件坏事。

sentences.en: But by the time I got out of the town hall, the president had suggested that.
sentences.zh: 但当我离开市政厅时，总统已经暗示了这一点。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He said, China should investigate Biden.
sentences.zh: 他说，中国应该调查拜登。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that shocked me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, I get shocked.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，我确实会感到震惊。

sentences.en: You know, I just, I think that it surprised me because I think if people take a breath and think about it, they do not want
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是觉得这让我很惊讶，因为我认为如果人们冷静下来思考一下，他们并不希望

sentences.en: Chinese influence and a North Korean cyber attack that helps one candidate over another.
sentences.zh: 看到中国的影响力和朝鲜的网络攻击来帮助某一位候选人胜过另一位。

sentences.en: I just don't think we want that.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得我们不希望那样。

sentences.en: And I know, I know I cannot accept that.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道，我知道我无法接受这一点。

sentences.en: So finally, Congresswoman, I have to imagine that you are an important perspective back in
sentences.zh: 那么最后，国会女议员，我想您在华盛顿一定有着重要的视角。

sentences.en: Washington.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿。

sentences.en: Swing district, newly elected somebody that your party cares very much about reelecting.
sentences.zh: 作为摇摆选区的议员，也是你们党非常看重连任的新当选议员。

sentences.en: So for your colleagues and helping them understand what's going on in America and how all of this
sentences.zh: 那么，对于您的同事们，为了帮助他们了解美国正在发生什么，以及这一切

sentences.en: is landing, what are you going to make sure that they hear when you get back to D.C.
sentences.zh: 是如何产生的，当您回到华盛顿时，您会确保让他们听到什么？

sentences.en: that you've learned from these events that you just did with voters?
sentences.zh: 您从刚才与选民的这些活动中学到了什么？

sentences.en: I would say it is extremely important that this process be handled with seriousness and judiciousness, that we maintain ourselves as the
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，以严肃和审慎的态度处理这一程序极其重要，我们要保持作为

sentences.en: adult in the room, that there's no need to come out of a meeting where you've heard some new
sentences.zh: 房间里成年人的姿态，没有必要在听到一些新的

sentences.en: testimony and just start talking to the press about how this seals the deal for you and you're done.
sentences.zh: 证词后就立刻跑去向媒体宣扬这如何让你下定决心，以及你已经受够了。

sentences.en: There are people who are seeking an objective process, not just a political process, and that we need to hear that because this is a big deal to take the country through this.
sentences.zh: 有些人寻求的是客观的程序，而不仅仅是政治程序，我们需要倾听这些声音，因为带领国家经历这一切是一件大事。

sentences.en: I have been encouraging and will certainly encourage my colleagues to treat it not as a political talking
sentences.zh: 我一直鼓励，也一定会鼓励我的同事们不要将其视为政治谈资，

sentences.en: point, but as a serious thing that history will reflect back on and that needs us to put the mission and the process above ourselves.
sentences.zh: 而是将其视为一件严肃的事情，历史会对此进行回顾，这需要我们将使命和程序置于个人之上。

sentences.en: So having absorbed a lot of talking points, you think it's really important that you not be spitting out a lot of talking points?
sentences.zh: 既然吸收了这么多谈资，您认为不吐露这些谈资真的很重要吗？

sentences.en: I'll be honest, I'm not sure if you're not directly involved in communicating on this, I'm not sure why you need to.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不确定，如果您没有直接参与这方面的沟通，我不确定您为什么需要这样做。

sentences.en: The facts are going to come in every single day.
sentences.zh: 事实每天都会浮现。

sentences.en: We're going to get new information every single day, but we need to be able to do more than just an impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 我们每天都会获得新的信息，但我们需要做的不仅仅是弹劾调查。

sentences.en: I would urge my colleagues to focus just as seriously on other legislation as they are on this inquiry.
sentences.zh: 我敦促我的同事们像关注这次调查一样，同样严肃地关注其他立法工作。

sentences.en: Well, Congresswoman Sluggan, thank you very much, and thank you for letting us tag along with you to these events.
sentences.zh: 好的，斯洛特金议员，非常感谢您，也感谢您让我们跟随您参加这些活动。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I mean, frankly, if you guys go ahead and impeach them, we may never have this meeting again, because you might be out of here and be replaced by our Republicans.
sentences.zh: 我是说，坦白讲，如果你们继续弹劾他们，我们可能再也不会有这样的会面了，因为你们可能已经出局，被我们的共和党人取代了。

sentences.en: And that would be sad because you seem like a bright young lady.
sentences.zh: 那会很遗憾，因为你看上去是一位聪明的年轻女士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I've been called young twice in the past 15 minutes, so I'm already ahead.
sentences.zh: 在过去的15分钟里，我已经两次被人称为年轻人了，所以我已经领先了。

sentences.en: In the days since Representative Slotkin called for an impeachment inquiry, two Republicans have announced their plans to challenge her in next year's election.
sentences.zh: 在斯洛特金众议员呼吁进行弹劾调查后的几天里，两名共和党人宣布了他们明年竞选中挑战她的计划。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: We were informed about an hour and a half ago by the attorney for Ambassador Sondland that the State Department would refuse to allow him to testify today.
sentences.zh: 大约一个半小时前，桑德兰大使的律师通知我们，国务院将拒绝让他今天作证。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, the White House blocked the scheduled deposition of Gordon Sondland, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，白宫阻止了原定于进行的戈登·桑德兰的证词录制，他是美国

sentences.en: ambassador to the European Union, and a key witness in the House impeachment inquiry.
sentences.zh: 驻欧盟大使，也是众议院弹劾调查中的关键证人。

sentences.en: Sondland's testimony was highly anticipated.
sentences.zh: 桑德兰的证词备受期待。

sentences.en: A series of text messages released last week revealed that he was deeply involved in the efforts to pressure Ukraine to investigate
sentences.zh: 上周公布的一系列短信显示，他深度参与了向乌克兰施压以调查

sentences.en: President Trump's political rivals.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统政治对手的行动。

sentences.en: After Sondland failed to show up, the chairman of the House
sentences.zh: 在桑德兰未能出席后，众议院

sentences.en: Intelligence Committee, Adam Schiff, called it an act of obstruction and said he would issue a subpoena demanding Sondland's deposition.
sentences.zh: 情报委员会主席亚当·希夫称此举为妨碍司法，并表示将发出传票要求桑德兰作证。

sentences.en: The failure to produce this witness, we consider yet additional strong evidence of obstruction of the constitutional functions of Congress, a co-equal branch of government.
sentences.zh: 未能提供这位证人，我们认为这是妨碍国会这一政府平等分支宪法职能的又一有力证据。

sentences.en: A few hours later, the White House sent a letter to House Democrats saying it would
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，白宫致信众议院民主党人，称将

sentences.en: cease cooperating with any element of the impeachment inquiry, calling it an illegitimate effort to overturn the results of the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 停止与弹劾调查的任何部分合作，称其为推翻2016年选举结果的非法努力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a new national poll found that support for impeachment is growing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一项新的全国民调发现，对弹劾的支持率正在上升。

sentences.en: The poll, conducted by The Washington Post and George Mason University, found that a majority
sentences.zh: 这项由《华盛顿邮报》和乔治梅森大学进行的民调发现，大多数

sentences.en: of Americans support the decision by House Democrats to begin an impeachment inquiry, and that nearly half of
sentences.zh: 美国人支持众议院民主党人启动弹劾调查的决定，并且近一半的

sentences.en: them say the House should recommend removing the president from office.
sentences.zh: 受访者表示众议院应该建议罢免总统。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·

sentences.en: Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee, tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
